# BSC (Bharat Steel Group) — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This corpus contains several hundred short call snippets, but genuine **sales** calls (rate enquiry, quantity/order negotiation, dealer price haggling, payment-for-material follow-up) are mixed in with a large volume of **internal logistics/ops chatter** — transporter coordination (Raipur/Nagpur/Chennai trailer brokers), driver "load ஆச்சா/இறக்கினீங்களா" check-ins, MTC/TC document chasing, crane/godown loading instructions, and several badly garbled/ASR-looped Telugu-Hindi transport-broker calls. A fair number of "sales" calls are also just **payment collection / PO follow-up / stock-check** calls rather than persuasive selling — this is a channel-sales (dealer/fabricator) business, not retail pitching, so most "selling" is actually **rate quoting + availability confirmation + closing logistics**. Given this mix, the signal on classic objection-handling and persuasive language is thinner than in a cold-calling B2C business; this KB is built only from the calls that show real commercial content (rate asked/given, quantity negotiated, PO/payment discussed, stock availability discussed).

## Products & brand ladder

**Flat/plate products (core of the business):**
- HR/MS Plates — thickness range seen: 2mm, 3mm, 4mm, 5mm, 6mm, 8mm, 10mm, 12mm, 16mm, 20mm, 25mm, 30mm, 36mm, 40mm, 45mm
- Checkered plate ("checker plate") — e.g., 8mm thickness, 1500mm width enquiries
- Standard stock sizes: coil-cut plates in 1250×2500mm ("8x4"), 1500mm width, 6300mm (≈6.3m) standard coil length; non-standard sizes (random length, 1500mm-wide heavy plates) called "rare"
- Grades: E250, E350, 250BR, 350BR (BR grade plates described as hard to get: *"E 350 BR-னா ரொம்ப rare தான் sir கிடைக்கிறது"* [E350 BR is very rare to get])

**Structural steel:**
- Angle, Channel (ISMC — 100×50, 75, 40mm sizes mentioned), Beam/Joist (ISMB, NPB, UB/UC — "Universal Beam", "high beams" 250mm), Flat bars
- Brands pushed for structural: "main mic" (main make/branded) vs "sale wise" (company's own trading stock)

**TMT Rebar:**
- Primary brands: SAIL, Vizag (RINL/RNL)
- Secondary/re-roll: Apollo, local re-roll mills, Suryodaya/Suryadev
- Sizes 8mm–36/40mm; grade Fe500/Fe550D discussed; note: *"500 கிடைக்காது sir... FE 500 stop பண்ணிட்டாங்க... RNL 3 months-ஆ production இல்ல"* [FE500 not available — RINL hasn't produced it for 3 months]

**Coils & pipes:** HR coils (cut-to-length service), Square tube, RHS/CHS pipes (often sourced out, not core stock)

**Binding wire:** MS/GI binding wire (project/site consumable, sold in small kg lots — 420-750kg)

## Real rates & terms (only rates actually appearing in calls)

- 6mm plate: **₹64/kg** market rate quoted on one call; 2-meter width adds **₹1,500/ton** premium → ~₹65,500 total mentioned
- 8mm/10mm/12mm thickness steel: **₹68–72 + tax** (increasing with thickness — "8mm 72, 10mm 70, 12mm 68" quoted by a plant buyer)
- Plate (40mm) market reference: **₹68 + tax**, with ex-Vizag TMT door delivery around **₹67/kg**
- TMT (E-Tata/branded) reference: **₹63.50/kg** vs company's own ask, customer pushing for 50 paisa match
- HR sheet (250BR grade), **₹67,300** quoted as "door delivery... final price," later flagged for **₹1,500/ton** monthly increase
- Channel/Beam differential example: NBP vs Joist — switching brand/section saves **₹2,000/ton**; 300×150 vs 300×140 section differs by **₹3,000** due to weight (42kg/m vs 46kg/m)
- Cutting charge: **₹500/ton** extra for custom length cutting from 12m stock
- "Coil to coil" discount: **₹500/ton cheaper** if customer takes the full coil including end-bits/scrap rather than asking for only the cut piece
